abstract: Maintains environmental preservation ratings and primary repository storage volume calculations
system_message:
You are the Senior archival conservator (CONS), responsible for maintaining environmental preservation ratings and primary repository storage volume calculations as well as monitoring luminescence containment across candidate emergency evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Luminescence containment（LUX）
information_points.content:
CONS-LUX-XY8：Under the Alpine Redoubt Repository Plan, the optical safety certificate specifies a maximum ambient lux level of 50 lx within active staging zones during artifact transfer.
CONS-LUX-IAT：For the Jura Cavern Archive Plan, the optical safety certificate records a maximum ambient lux level of 75 lx in active staging zones during artifact handling.
CONS-LUX-I8O：The optical safety certificate for the Mittelland Sub-Basement Depository Plan establishes a maximum ambient lux level of 30 lx across active staging zones during artifact transfer.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental preservation ratings and primary repository storage volume calculations（ENV）
information_points.content:
CONS-ENV-XY7：According to the depository architectural ledger, the Jura Cavern Archive Plan provides a primary repository storage volume of 340 m3 in designated Class-A subterranean archive containment chambers.
CONS-ENV-60B：For the Alpine Redoubt Repository Plan, the architectural ledger indicates a primary repository storage volume of 480 m3 across designated Class-A subterranean archive containment chambers.
CONS-ENV-PMB：The Mittelland Sub-Basement Depository Plan offers a primary repository storage volume of 480 m3 within designated Class-A subterranean archive containment chambers according to architectural ledgers.
